fields.description: Descriptive label.
fields.label: Charge Description

fields.description: How this line was priced: Service Quantity (has an SQI -- days, tiers, ERUs), Consumption / Demand (bare unit, classified by the uom_class seed), Flat (neither), Unclassified Unit (unit the seed does not know). Structural -- never a test on a client-configured code value.
fields.label: Charge Basis

fields.description: What the segment billed: the sum of its calculation HEADERS (CI_BSEG_CALC.CALC_AMT). Not the calc lines: lines are itemisation and some clients itemise selectively (Newark: most headers carry no lines), so a line sum undercounts there. See "Itemized Charge Amount" for what the lines cover.
fields.label: Billed Amount

fields.description: Currency measure, additive at this canvas's grain.
fields.label: Base Amount

fields.description: Currency measure, additive at this canvas's grain.
fields.label: Exempt Amount

fields.description: NOT ADDITIVE. The quantity billed by ONE rate component. Several components can bill the same quantity, so summing this overstates usage -- measured against CI_BSEG_SQ it agrees for only 66% of segments, overstating by up to 3.75x. To total usage, use "Billed Usage" on rpt_billed_usage or rpt_bill_segment.
fields.label: Billed Quantity (Per Rate Component)

fields.description: On rpt_bill_segment: Consumption Charge Amount / Billed Usage -- the unit price of METERED CONSUMPTION only, because dividing the full billed amount by usage overstates the price by the daily, service-quantity and flat charges (60% of ellensburg revenue). On rpt_billed_charge: this line's amount over this line's quantity. Null unless the quantity is a single unit of measure.
fields.label: Average Price Per Unit

rpt_financial_txn.label: Financial Transaction

premade_reports.description: Every movement of money in C2M is a financial transaction. Splitting by type separates what was charged from what was paid from what was reversed.
premade_reports.title: What is the financial position, by transaction type?

premade_reports.description: Adjustments are the manual override on an automated system. A type that grows is a process people have stopped trusting.
premade_reports.title: What is being adjusted, and by how much?

premade_reports.description: Revenue class is how a utility reports itself to a regulator. Anything unclassified here is revenue that cannot be reported. Non-revenue service agreements are excluded — see "How much of what we bill is not revenue?" for what came out and why.
premade_reports.title: Where does revenue come from, by revenue class?

rpt_financial_txn.use_case: Every financial transaction (bills, payments, adjustments, deposits, write-offs, refunds) for balance and revenue questions.

fields.description: Which configured GL extract shipped this transaction (C1-GLFCX, GL Extract for Oracle Financial Cloud, at the reference client). Run numbers are issued PER BATCH CODE, so this column QUALIFIES the Run Number beside it: reconcile a GL file on the pair, never on the run number alone. Most clients configure a single extract and this reads as a constant; demo25 runs two (C1-GLFCX and GLDL), which is why the column is on the canvas at all.
fields.label: GL Extract Batch Code

fields.description: Which run of the GL extract shipped this transaction to the financial system, numbered WITHIN its GL Extract Batch Code -- read the two together, because run 5 of one extract is a different file from run 5 of another. Null until the transaction has been extracted, which is the same population as a null Transferred to GL Date.
fields.label: GL Extract Run Number

fields.description: True once the transaction has been picked up by a GL extract run. False means it is still waiting, which is the normal state of recent activity rather than a data problem: at the reference client roughly 47 percent of transactions are in this state at any time.
